subject: Mplus and Lavaan DF difference in Growth Modeling

messages.author: 762bb7a725be3e9e
messages.subject: Mplus and Lavaan DF difference in Growth Modeling
parts:
Hi, my name is Marcel, a researcher at the Jaume I University.
I'm working on a Latent Growth Model with Mplus and Lavaan. I have a problem with the DF.
In Mplus I have 16 DF, but in Lavaan I got 15 DF.
There is a 1 DF difference between both softwares, and I don't understand if there is a mistake, or it is because Lavaan works in a different way than Mplus.
Here are Mplus and Lavaan syntax for the same model.
I'd appreciate it if someone could help me with this.

Mplus syntax:
VARIABLE:
    NAMES ARE Id V1-V6;
model:
      eta0 by V1@1 V2@1 V3@1 V4@1 V5@1 V6@1;
       eta1 BY v1*-0.00001 (lambda11);
       eta1 BY v2*-0.00003 (lambda21);
       eta1 BY v3*-0.00004 (lambda31);
       eta1 BY v4*-0.00006 (lambda41);
       eta1 BY v5*-0.00007 (lambda51);
       eta1 BY v6*-0.00008 (lambda61);

       [eta0*68];
      [eta1*.8] ;
      [V1-V6@0];
       V1@0;             

       eta0*22 eta1*50;
      eta0 with eta1*-.3;

  model constraint:
     new(b2*.5);

      lambda11 = 1 - exp(b2*1);
      lambda21 = 1 - exp(b2*2);
      lambda31 = 1 - exp(b2*3);
      lambda41 = 1 - exp(b2*4);
      lambda51 = 1 - exp(b2*5);
      lambda61 = 1 - exp(b2*6);

  ANALYSIS:
    TYPE IS MISSING;
    ESTIMATOR IS MLR;                
    ITERATIONS = 100000;
    CONVERGENCE = 0.00005;
    COVERAGE = 0.10;



Lavaan syntax:
'
eta0 =~ 1*V1 + 1*V2 + 1*V3 + 1*V4 + 1*V5 + 1*V6

eta1 =~  start(-0.00001)*lambda11*V1
eta1 =~  start(-0.00003)*lambda21*V2
eta1 =~  start(-0.00004)*lambda31*V3  
eta1 =~  start(-0.00006)*lambda41*V4
eta1 =~  start(-0.00007)*lambda51*V5
eta1 =~  start(-0.00008)*lambda61*V6 

#means constrained
  V1 ~ 0*1
  V2 ~ 0*1
  V3 ~ 0*1
  V4 ~ 0*1
  V5 ~ 0*1
  V6 ~ 0*1

 #variances constrained
  V1 ~~ 0*V1
eta0 ~~ -.3*eta1

#START VALUES and means 
  eta0 ~ start(22)*68
  eta1 ~ start(50)*.8

#Mplus model constraints

      b2 =~ 0*V1   #phantom variable as Mplus
      b2 ~~ 0*b2
      b2 ~ 0*1 + label("b2")*1 + .50?1   #mean fixed to 0, labelled and start values of .50

     lambda11 == 1 - exp(b2*1)
     lambda21 == 1 - exp(b2*2)
     lambda31 == 1 - exp(b2*3)
     lambda41 == 1 - exp(b2*4)
     lambda51 == 1 - exp(b2*5)
     lambda61 == 1 - exp(b2*6)
'

Thanks in advance

Marcel
